1.t: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-

2.t: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,

3.t: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.

4.t: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-

6.t: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

7.t: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.

8.t: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?

10.t: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-

11.t: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.

12.t: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!

13.t: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"

14.t: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!

15.t: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.

16.t: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.

17.t: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!

18.t: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.

19.t: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?

21.t: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).

22.t: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:

23.t: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):

24.t: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.

25.t: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:

26.t: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:

27.t: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:

28.t: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.

29.t: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,

30.t: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);

31.t: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

32.t: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"

33.t: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!

34.t: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:

35.t: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).

36.t: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
